title: Hasselt, Limburg — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hasselt, Limburg: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hasselt is a city in Limburg with a population of 78,000. The capital of Belgian Limburg, known for its fashion museum, Japanese garden, and vibrant Jenever (gin) distilling tradition. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
